message: Renovate proposes GitHub Actions updates after 1 hour (minimumReleaseAge: "1 hour" in packageRules[0] of renovate.json), but cooldown.minimum in depcurfew.json is 3 days, which covers the actions the workflows run; its pull requests bring in versions of actions younger than that
fix: Make minimumReleaseAge in packageRules[0] of renovate.json at least 3 days, or limit the rule to the actions that need a shorter delay
